exposure: Gestational age at delivery (37, 38, 39, and 40 weeks)
Analysis was performed for the whole cohort and for the subgroup of insulin-dependent pregnancies.
outcome: Perinatal death (stillbirth or neonatal death within 28 days of birth)
Composite adverse neonatal event (assisted ventilation >30 minutes, birth injury, seizures, or 5-minute Apgar score ≤3)
cohort: 4,905 singleton, nonanomalous infants of diabetic pregnancies from the Missouri birth registry between January 1, 1989 to December 31, 2005
finding: The risk of perinatal death at any gestational age examined was low (3/1,000 births or lower), as was the risk of the adverse perinatal outcome (<2%).
